# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

## Getting help

This is a public research and engineering showcase, not a hosted customer-support service. For usage questions, reproducible bugs or suggested improvements, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/dangkhoa2016/Rails-8-AI-Customer-Support-Desk/issues).

Before opening an issue:

1. Read the [README](../README.md) and [local development guide](../docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md).
2. Check for a similar existing issue.
3. Report exact Ruby/Rails/PostgreSQL versions and sanitized reproduction steps.
4. Confirm the issue occurs with synthetic fixtures and without private secrets.

## Security and licensing

Do not file public issues for vulnerabilities, tokens, real customer data or sensitive deployment details. Report vulnerabilities privately using [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Model licensing questions are covered in [MODEL_LICENSES.md](../docs/MODEL_LICENSES.md).

Community support is best-effort, without guaranteed availability, response time or production support obligations.
